paragraphs.source_en: Just as the war in Korea was drastically altering Toyotomi Hideyoshi's fate, Lady Yodo's destiny also took an unexpected turn.

paragraphs.source_en: After Tsurumatsumaru's untimely death, Chacha had become merely an ordinary concubine in the encampment at Nagoya. Lady Matsunomaru, who had accompanied her to Nagoya, was instead able to draw closer to Hideyoshi; increasingly favored, she vigorously expanded her influence. Both were childless concubines, and in beauty and talent Lady Matsunomaru may even have surpassed Chacha.

paragraphs.source_en: Of course, Chacha no longer possessed that former fierce ambition and jealousy. The wound Tsurumatsumaru's death had left in her heart was far deeper than any of that. For what purpose had Tsurumatsumaru come into this world at all? For a time, as Tsurumatsumaru's mother, she had dreamed that he would one day inherit the House of the Kanpaku, but his early death had swiftly turned that dream to despair.

paragraphs.source_en: After all the upheavals she had endured, Chacha's disposition had changed greatly. At first she had been self-important, willful, and proud, but after Tsurumatsumaru's death she became an ordinary woman.
